question: Which of the following pathologies has its origin in the arrest of the bile flow that partially or totally prevents the arrival of bile in the duodenum ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Cholestasis" -> "Arrest of bile flow" -> "Prevents bile arrival in the duodenum" -> 95% CHAIN: "Cholestasis" -> "Impaired bile flow" -> "Obstructs bile passage to the duodenum" -> 90% CHAIN: "Cholestasis" -> "Bile accumulation in the liver" -> "Lack of bile in the duodenum" -> 95%
analysis: Cholestasis is the pathology that has its origin in the arrest of the bile flow that partially or totally prevents the arrival of bile in the duodenum.
